prompt: Implement chunkSums to split the array into consecutive chunks of the given size and return the sum of each chunk; the final chunk may be shorter.
explanation: The number of chunks is the ceiling of length / size, computed in integer math as (length + size - 1) / size, which also yields 0 chunks for an empty array. Chunk c starts at index c * size, and clamping its end with Math.min(start + size, a.length) is what lets the final short chunk work without an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException. An inner loop then sums each clamped range.
hints: Count chunks with ceiling division: (a.length + size - 1) / size.
Chunk c covers indexes c * size up to (but not including) c * size + size.
Clamp the end of each chunk with Math.min(start + size, a.length) so the last, shorter chunk stays in bounds.
